s: While wearing these boots, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You must have occupied that space at some point during the current turn.
While wearing this helmet, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.

This tool takes the form of a wrench, a screwdriver, or another basic tool. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can touch the item and transform it into a type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice. Whatever form the tool takes, you have proficiency with it when you use it.

The item has 4 charges. When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 1 of the item's charges to succeed instead. The item regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn.
You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} while wielding this shield.

The shield has 4 charges. While holding it, when a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend 1 of the shield's charges and push the attacker up to 15 feet straight away. The shield regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn.

While wearing this ring, you can recover one expended spell slot as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The recovered slot can be of level 3 or lower. Once used, the ring can't be used again until the next dawn.
